update ord_dir_order
order_status_code = #{item.orderStatusCode},
order_amount = #{item.orderAmount},

updater = #{item.updater},

where id = #{item.id} and biz_org_code = #{item.bizOrgCode}

mapper.select: SELECT odod.real_unit_price FROM ord_dir_order odo INNER JOIN ord_dir_order_detail odod ON odod.order_id = odo.id AND odod.is_delete = 0 where odo.request_order_id = #{requestOrderId} and odo.is_delete =0

select sum(total_amount) from ord_dir_deliv_request where store_code = #{storeCode} and order_type_config_id = #{orderTypeConfigId} and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and is_delete = 0 and truncation_date_time < CURDATE() GROUP BY order_cycle_id ORDER BY id desc limit 30

select count(o.id) from ord_dir_order_cycle oc inner JOIN ord_dir_order o on oc.id = o.order_cycle_id where oc.truncation_date_time = #{truncationDateTime} and o.store_code = #{storeCode} and o.source_code = #{sourceCode} and o.order_status_code != 'invalid' and o.is_delete = 0

update.foreach: update ord_dir_order set source_code = #{sourceCode} where id = #{item}
